invariants.statement: The repository itself remains the Genesis establishment surface; no separate pre-Genesis authority tree is introduced.
FS0-GENESIS remains intact as the historical functional set and Plan after accepted state is established.
Persistent accepted normative authority is repository-level state and is not semantically owned by the historical Plan that introduced it.
Genesis authority does not depend on prototype-repository provenance, branch ancestry, or an external source revision.
Internal accepted-state revision binding is permitted and required for normal successor framework Planning.
Design owns semantics, Planning owns normative distillation and implementation intent, and Build owns implementation correctness.
Governance, Conformance, and Assurance remain distinct authority-bearing keystones.
Conformance applicability and Assurance applicability are independent dimensions stored once with accepted normative authority.
Each Conformance assertion has exactly one normative owner; implementation may be shared.
File realization planning does not determine which normative assertions execute.
repo/scripts/validate is the sole public canonical repository Conformance entry point and contains no independent normative semantics.
Genesis implements only the framework substrate required for self-hosted successor framework development; later proposal capabilities remain eligible for later functional sets.
The initializer is a product and is not implemented by FS0-GENESIS.
FS0-CORE is a product-root concept and is not used as the framework Genesis root.
README.md, AGENTS.md, and LICENSE are part of the portable Genesis repository root and are explicitly authorized by the Genesis Plan rather than introduced as incidental Build output.

Root README and agent guidance may explain repository authority and workflow but do not independently own or extend normative semantics; LICENSE is legal reuse text and does not define framework authority.

Genesis preserves exact Design revisions as content-addressed historical input snapshots solely to make the root portable without prototype history; those snapshots are non-authoritative and do not establish duplication as the ordinary successor Planning model.
The initial commit of the derived FS0-GENESIS repository is the repository provenance horizon: post-Genesis lineage begins at that revision and does not require prototype or pre-root Git ancestry.
GitHub issues, pull requests, reviews, workflow runs, and merge state provide governed provenance and evidence surfaces but do not independently own normative authority.

The repository persists Conformance evidence identities/obligations and Assurance correspondence/obligation definitions, while per-candidate Assurance findings and execution receipts remain on governed issue/PR evidence surfaces.
Continuous integration is a thin exact-candidate orchestration layer over repo/scripts/validate and shall not become a competing Conformance authority or validator.
